hooks.command: jq -r '(.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path) // empty' | { read -r f; echo "$f" | grep -qE '/specs/[^/]+/tasks\.md$' || exit 0; grep -qE '^- \[x\]' "$f" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; d=$(dirname "$f"); jq -n --arg d "$d" '{systemMessage: ("tasks.md has checked items — append a dated Delivery Log entry in " + $d + "/plan.md evidencing the Acceptance Criterion it satisfies.")}'; } 2>/dev/null || true

{
  [ -d specs ] || exit 0
  stale=""
  for dir in specs/*/; do
    [ -d "$dir" ] || continue
    slug=$(basename "$dir")
    case "$slug" in _template|_archive) continue ;; esac
    feature_slug=$(echo "$slug" | sed -E 's/^[0-9]{3}-//')
    if ! git branch -a 2>/dev/null | grep -qE "/${feature_slug}\$"; then
      stale="$stale $slug"
    fi
  done
  for f in specs/*.md; do
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    slug=$(basename "$f" .md)
    echo "$slug" | grep -qE '^[0-9]{3}-' || continue
    feature_slug=$(echo "$slug" | sed -E 's/^[0-9]{3}-//')
    if ! git branch -a 2>/dev/null | grep -qE "/${feature_slug}\$"; then
      stale="$stale $slug"
    fi
  done
  [ -n "$stale" ] || exit 0
  jq -n --arg s "$stale" '{systemMessage: ("No matching branch for spec(s):" + $s + " — if they shipped, archive: git mv specs/<item> specs/_archive/<item>")}'
} 2>/dev/null || true

{ branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); case "$branch" in */*) slug="${branch#*/}";; *) exit 0;; esac; [ -n "$slug" ] && [ -d specs ] || exit 0; ls specs 2>/dev/null | grep -qE "^[0-9]{3}-${slug}(\.md)?\$" && exit 0; jq -n --arg b "$branch" --arg s "$slug" '{systemMessage: ("No specs/NNN-" + $s + " (folder or .md file) found for branch \"" + $b + "\" — soft reminder per .claude/rules/spec-driven-development.md (skip for exempt one-line fixes).")}'; } 2>/dev/null || true
